No prominent party, named characters, text, labels, grids, UI, collage, borders, logos or watermark. The location is the subject. Match its description; do not replace it with a generic room. Where the environment permits, retain some unobstructed ordinary surface for later authored localized overlays, without highlighting that surface or implying a secret. Do not bake any actual campaign secrets into the image.

Environment: A traversable gap between high mountain slopes with a narrow road or trail; use for overland routes through a mountain range.

Spatial relationships: Lead the route between opposing slopes toward the saddle beyond.
Environment constraints: Highland exposure; snow depends on selected climate and season.
Setting: Natural mountain crossing; no fixed fortress or bridge.
Avoid: summit-only viewpoint; flat grass plain.
Art direction: Original cinematic painterly fantasy environment illustration, believable materials and architecture, wide establishing shot, readable at small display sizes. The location is the subject; any inhabitants are incidental and do not imply a specific party or encounter. No text, labels, UI, map grid, collage, borders, logos or watermark.
Variant direction: A visibly well-kept version with refined craftsmanship; asymmetrical wide composition and soft directional light.
